INSERT INTO applications (
  user_id, job_id, status, applied_at, last_activity, notes, created_at, updated_at
) VALUES (
  $1,
  $2,
  'interested',
  NOW(),
  NOW(),
  $3,
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (user_id, job_id) DO UPDATE SET
  last_activity = NOW(),
  updated_at = NOW()

  id AS application_id,

  status,
  applied_at,
  last_activity,
  notes;

UPDATE applications
SET
  status = $1,
  last_activity = NOW(),
  updated_at = NOW(),
  applied_at = CASE WHEN $1 = 'applied' AND applied_at IS NULL THEN NOW() ELSE applied_at END,
  notes = COALESCE($2, notes)
WHERE id = $3
  AND user_id = $4
RETURNING
  id AS application_id,
  user_id,
  job_id,
  status,
  applied_at,
  last_activity,
  notes;

  interview_type,

  user_id,

  to_status,
  metadata,

SELECT

  $2,

UPDATE follow_up_log
SET
  response_status = $1,
  responded_at = CASE WHEN $1 = 'replied' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $2
  AND application_id = $3
RETURNING id, application_id, followup_type, response_status;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_sent,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN response_status = 'replied' THEN 1 END) AS total_replied,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN response_status = 'no_response' THEN 1 END) AS no_response,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN response_status = 'bounced' THEN 1 END) AS bounced,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN response_status = 'pending' THEN 1 END) AS pending,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN response_status = 'replied' THEN 1 END)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN response_status != 'pending' THEN 1 END), 0),
  1) AS response_rate_pct
FROM follow_up_log
WHERE user_id = $1;

SELECT
  a.id AS application_id,
  a.job_id,
  a.user_id,
  a.status,
  a.interview_date,
  a.interview_type,
  a.interviewer_name,
  a.interviewer_role,
  a.interview_location,
  j.title AS job_title,
  j.company_name,
  j.company_url,
  j.location AS job_location,

  j.requirements AS job_requirements,

  u.email,
  u.full_name,
  up.skills,

  up.min_salary,

  up.work_type,
  cr.company_overview,

FROM applications a

parameters.jsCode:
const job = $input.first().json;
const userSkills = Array.isArray(job.userSkills) ? job.userSkills : [];
const userJobTitles = Array.isArray(job.userJobTitles) ? job.userJobTitles : [];
const userIndustries = Array.isArray(job.userIndustries) ? job.userIndustries : [];
const preferredLocations = Array.isArray(job.preferredLocations) ? job.preferredLocations : [];

const prompt = 'You are a career matching AI. Analyze this job against the user profile and return ONLY a valid JSON object with no additional text.\n'
  + '## User Profile:\n'
  + '- Skills: ' + (userSkills.join(', ') || 'Not specified') + '\n'
  + '- Experience: ' + (job.experienceYears || 0) + ' years\n'
  + '- Desired Job Titles: ' + (userJobTitles.join(', ') || 'Not specified') + '\n'
  + '- Preferred Industries: ' + (userIndustries.length ? userIndustries.join(', ') : 'Any') + '\n'
  + '- Minimum Salary: $' + (job.minSalary || 0) + '\n'
  + '- Preferred Locations: ' + (preferredLocations.join(', ') || 'Any') + '\n'
  + '- Work Type Preference: ' + (job.preferredWorkType || 'Any') + '\n'
  + '## Job Posting:\n'
  + '- Title: ' + (job.jobTitle || 'Unknown') + '\n'
  + '- Company: ' + (job.companyName || 'Unknown') + '\n'
  + '- Location: ' + (job.jobLocation || 'Not specified') + '\n'
  + '- Work Type: ' + (job.jobWorkType || 'Not specified') + '\n'
  + '- Employment Type: ' + (job.employmentType || 'Not specified') + '\n'
  + '- Salary Range: $' + (job.salaryMin || 'N/A') + ' - $' + (job.salaryMax || 'N/A') + '\n'
  + '## Job Description:\n' + (job.description || '').substring(0, 2000) + '\n'
  + '## Requirements:\n' + (job.requirements || '').substring(0, 1000) + '\n'
  + '---\nReturn ONLY this JSON (no markdown, no backticks):\n'
  + '{"matchScore":<0-100>,"reasoning":"<2-3 sentences>","skillsMatched":["skill"],"skillsMissing":["skill"],"salaryMatch":<bool>,"locationMatch":<bool>,"recommendation":"<apply|consider|skip>"}';

return [{ json: { ...job, requestBody: { model: 'llama-3.1-8b-instant', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }], temperature: 0.3, max_tokens: 500 } } }];

const user = $('Prepare User Profile').first().json;
return [{ json: { user_id: user.user_id } }];
